phase_name: Build the reflow tool and produce scratch chunks

objectives.description: Implement paragraph-reflow pass with indent window + atomic/enum cues
Insert only Phase 2 headings at recorded offsets
Run unmodified literature-chunk.sh into scratch dir
Inspect chunks.json titles for real headings, no self-dup breadcrumbs

approaches_tried.approach: Enumerated-list markers (i)/(ii)/(a)/Stage-N always force a new paragraph, per literal task wording
approaches_tried.reason: Split Definition 1.1.4's own nested (1)/(2)/(3)/(i)-(viii) sub-items into many small paragraphs, exposing it to a mid-definition chunk cut by literature-chunk.sh's Pass-2 size merge (no atomic-block awareness below top-level heading-chunk boundary).

approaches_tried.approach: Flip enum markers to never force a new paragraph (stay glued to preceding text)
approaches_tried.reason: Fixed most of the fragmentation but Definition 1.1.4 was still split, because a single blank line surrounding a centered math-display insert (pure typesetting) still triggered a flush between the definition's own sub-clauses.

approaches_tried.approach: One-line-lookahead blank-line suppression inside atomic-keyword-opened paragraphs, plus fixing an ENUM_RE regex bug that failed to match the OCR-fused adjacent marker '(l)(i)'
approaches_tried.reason: Definition 1.1.4 verified complete in a single scratch chunk (opening 'quintuple' phrase through closing '(viii)' clause); aggregate profile stayed healthy (38 chunks / 1669.5B mean / 5.3% under 300B).

deviations.reason: Empirically required the opposite polarity (never a paragraph trigger, always glued to the preceding text) to keep atomic Definition/Lemma/Theorem statements intact against literature-chunk.sh's paragraph-level Pass-2 merge, which has no sub-heading-chunk atomic-block awareness.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — see phase-4 deviation note in the plan file)*
